title: Coordinator dashboard — round 1
summary: Test a coordinator's event queue and the connected registration flow.
heading: Can a coordinator understand today and register a guest without losing context?
intro: This fictional review demonstrates a connected prototype, region-level annotation, recommended decisions and a compiled handoff. None of its names or records refer to a real organisation.

principles.title: Actions over totals
principles.detail: Lead with work the coordinator can progress today.

principles.title: Keep context
principles.detail: Move between the queue and registration without losing the selected event.

principles.title: Confirm consequences
principles.detail: Show capacity and accessibility effects before reserving a place.

mocks.title: Coordinator dashboard
mocks.description: Filter the queue, select an event and enter the connected registration flow.

mocks.title: Guest registration
mocks.description: Choose a guest, add access needs and preview the reservation outcome.

questions.title: What should dominate the coordinator's landing view?
questions.prompt: The first viewport can emphasize actionable exceptions or overall programme totals.
questions.recommendation: Lead with events needing attention; keep totals as a compact orientation strip.

options.label: Action queue
options.detail: Prioritise capacity, staffing and reply work.

options.label: Programme totals
options.detail: Lead with registrations, capacity and attendance trends.

options.label: Calendar
options.detail: Make the week the primary navigation model.

questions.title: When should a reservation be confirmed?
questions.prompt: Accessibility requests can affect room layout but should not create unnecessary friction.
questions.recommendation: Show a lightweight preview for every registration and add an explicit warning only when capacity or layout is affected.

options.label: Always preview
options.detail: A compact summary appears before the final reservation.

options.label: Preview exceptions
options.detail: Routine reservations save immediately; exceptional ones show impact.

options.label: Save immediately
options.detail: Optimise for speed and rely on undo for corrections.

questions.title: What should the next round cover?
questions.prompt: Review completion is a design checkpoint, not build approval.
questions.recommendation: Test the same connected task at mobile width before compiling the implementation specification.

options.label: Mobile workflow
options.detail: Check hierarchy and task continuity on a phone.

options.label: Reporting view
options.detail: Explore attendance and capacity analysis next.

options.label: Prepare specification
options.detail: Treat this round as sufficient and write the final build spec.

handoff.complete: This review is complete. Use its decisions to prepare the next design artifact, then request explicit authorization before implementation.
handoff.inProgress: This review is still in progress. Preserve unanswered decisions and do not begin implementation.
